_note: Frozen BEFORE any candidate results exist. Changes after results are accepted require an ADR explaining why the original criterion was invalid and a full rerun of all affected candidates.

hard_gates.description: No separately installed end-user runtime or toolchain is required.
Every Host Probe filesystem, lease, process, Unicode-path, signature, and result-contract case passes on every required native host.
Unity-like and MCP-like long-running process trees can be started, timed out, cancelled, and cleaned reliably.
Success, crash, timeout, and cancellation leave no live child process or active lease.
Each target produces a reproducible, checksummed artifact that can participate in native platform signing.
Candidate and dependency licenses are compatible with Kinglet distribution and completely recorded.
Structured errors and committed evidence contain no forbidden secrets or absolute user paths.
Windows execution is native and uses neither WSL nor Git Bash.
The canonical manifest and structured result behaviors are implementable without a blocking platform limitation.

scoring_bands.0: blocking — the capability is absent or critically broken
scoring_bands.1: high risk — serious gaps or unresolved platform issues
scoring_bands.2: material risk — notable issues that will require significant mitigation
scoring_bands.3: acceptable — meets the bar with minor concerns
scoring_bands.4: strong — clear capability with well-evidenced behavior
scoring_bands.5: best evidenced — exceeds the bar with thorough, reproducible evidence

scoring_rules.qualitative_requirements: Each non-measured score requires an evidence record ID and a reviewer rationale string.
scoring_rules.disqualification: Any failed or open hard gate disqualifies the candidate from weighted scoring. A failed gate is committed evidence, not a low score.
tie_break_order: lower risk preserving tested existing behavior
